name: Knightfall Chess
description: A legal-move chess engine with check/checkmate, castling, en passant, promotion, undo and a minimax opponent.

name: PAC//MAZE
description: Arcade maze chase using shortest-path ghost pursuit, power pellets, collision and scoring.

description: CSV-driven strategy lab: moving-average crossovers, fees, equity curves, drawdown and trade history.

name: Vision / Motion

name: ChainForge

name: Sentinel SOC

name: Neural Playground
description: Train a small multilayer neural net from scratch on nonlinear decision boundaries in your browser.

name: Growth Experiments

name: Cloud Reliability Lab
description: Explore fault domains, dependent services and Monte Carlo availability under synthetic failure assumptions.

name: Climate Pulse
description: Fetch live weather and air quality from Open-Meteo; map measurements to a time-series chart.
